title: Through the 2000 and 2008 crashes the half-capital 2x barbells, rebalanced yearly, still fell 54–60% (Taiwan 50 proxy −65%); 50% Taiwan 50 + 50% gold kept it to −36%; no rebalancing rule beat annual in both halves
strategy: six fixed Taiwan 50 / 2x / gold / T-bill portfolios x five rebalancing rules
question: Over 1997–2026, including the 2000–2002 and 2008 crashes, do the half-capital 2x barbells keep a smaller worst drawdown than 100% Taiwan 50, and which rebalancing rule is best?
hypothesis: The barbells' smaller drawdown in 2014–2026 survives a sample with two Taiwan crashes; more frequent rebalancing lowers drawdown further.

findings.title: A 2008-type crash takes the yearly-rebalanced barbells to −54% to −60%
findings.detail: Annual rebalance, 1997–2026: Taiwan 50 proxy −64.64% (2000–2001); 2x + T-bills −54.46%, 2x + gold −58.35%, 2x + gold + T-bills −56.41%. Smaller than the proxy's, so they 'hold up' by the fixed reading, but about twice the −26–27% seen in 2014–2026.
findings.title_zh: 2008 等級崩盤時，每年調回的正二組合跌 54–60%

findings.title: 50% Taiwan 50 + 50% gold without leverage: −36%
findings.detail: Annual rebalance: max drawdown −35.57% at 10.23% CAGR against the proxy's −64.64% at 8.93%; in the GFC −34.50% against −56.97%.

findings.title: 2x + gold has the highest return of the annual-rebalance portfolios
findings.detail: 14.14% CAGR against 8.93% for the proxy (band10 rebalancing: 14.44%); its crash drawdown is close to the proxy's.
findings.title_zh: 每年調回的組合中，正二＋黃金報酬最高
findings.detail_zh: 年化 14.14%，台股代理 8.93%（偏離 ±10% 才調為 14.44%）；崩盤回檔接近台股。

findings.title: No rebalancing rule beat annual in both halves
findings.detail: Quarterly and band rules buy more 2x as it falls and deepen crash drawdowns. Never rebalancing gave 2x + T-bills −37.20% over the full period (−33.38% in 1997–2013) but −37.20% in 2014–2026 against −26.14% annual. The halves are slices of one path, so 'none' in 2014–2026 carries 16 years of drift.
findings.title_zh: 沒有一種調回規則在兩段期間都勝過每年一次
findings.detail_zh: 每季或偏離就調，會在下跌途中一直加碼正二，加深崩盤回檔。完全不調：正二＋公債整段 −37.20%（1997–2013 −33.38%），但 2014–2026 −37.20% 對每年調回 −26.14%。兩段是同一條路徑的切片。

card_summary: Over 1997–2026 with the 2000 and 2008 crashes, half-capital 2x barbells rebalanced yearly still fell 54–60% (Taiwan 50 proxy −65%). 50% Taiwan 50 + 50% gold without leverage held it to −36%. No rebalancing rule beat annual in both halves.
title_zh: 經過 2000 與 2008 崩盤，每年調回的半數正二組合仍跌 54–60%（台股 −65%）；0050＋黃金各半只跌 36%；沒有一種調回規則在兩段期間都勝過每年一次
question_zh: 把期間拉到 1997–2026、包含 2000–2002 與 2008 崩盤，半數正二組合的最大回檔還會比全部持有台股小嗎？哪一種調回規則最好？
hypothesis_zh: 2014–2026 的降回檔效果在含崩盤的樣本中仍成立；調回越頻繁回檔越小。
card_summary_zh: 1997–2026 含 2000 與 2008 崩盤：每年調回的半數正二組合仍跌 54–60%（台股代理 −65%）。不用槓桿的 0050＋黃金各半只跌 36%。每季、偏離 ±5% 或 ±10% 才調、不調，都沒有在兩段期間同時勝過每年一次。
limitations_zh: 台股代理 = 加權 + 年 3.0%；2014–2026 年每年比真實 0050 少 3.6 個百分點，絕對報酬偏低。
合成正二 = 2 × 代理 − 年 2.0%（敏感度 4.0%）；2014 年前沒有真實正二。
2008 年 3 月前黃金為週收盤，低估日波動；紐約收盤延後一個台股交易日對齊。
單一 29 年路徑；兩次台股崩盤。
未計交易成本以外的稅。
interpretation_zh: 把期間拉到 1997–2026 年，包含 2000 和 2008 兩次崩盤後，每年調回的正二組合最大回檔仍有 −54% 到 −60%，只比單抱台股的 −65% 好一些；平時看到的 −26% 不代表崩盤時的風險。不用槓桿的 0050＋黃金各半，29 年最大回檔約 −36%。調回頻率方面，每年一次就夠，調得越頻繁越會在下跌途中加碼正二。
